CREO Fenestrated: Fenestrated Thoracolumbar Pedicle Screw System
The CREO Fenestrated Pedicle screw system by Globus Medical is a versatile cannulated modular screw system that uses a common screw shank of various sizes and can be used with the modular heads of the CREO AMP or MIS screw tower. The Fenestrated screw is intended to be used with Globus FORTRESS cement.
